description: This file contains utility functions for processing and cleaning assistant-visible text, including stripping tags related to code regions, reasoning tags, model tokens, and tool call XML tags.

methods.name: endsInsideQuotedString
methods.description: Checks if a given range inside a string ends inside a quoted string, considering escape characters.

methods.name: isToolCallBoundary
methods.description: Determines if a character signifies a boundary for a tool call tag.

methods.name: findTagCloseIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of the closing '>' for an HTML/XML tag, considering quoted strings.

methods.name: looksLikeToolCallPayloadStart
methods.description: Checks if the text at a given position looks like the start of a tool call JSON payload.

methods.name: parseToolCallTagAt
methods.description: Parses a tool call XML tag at a specific position in the text.

methods.name: stripToolCallXmlTags
methods.description: Removes or hides tool call XML tags from the text, handling nested and truncated tags.

methods.name: stripRelevantMemoriesTags
methods.description: Removes relevant memories tags from the text.
